# quota-pacer v1.0.14

## 更新内容

### 中文

- 修复一个会导致 Claude/Codex 主动探测被永久饿死的 bug：被动配额观测（v1.0.12 引入）在写入缓存时会刷新 `ObservedAt`，而 TTL 到期判断此前直接复用 `ObservedAt` 作为时钟——只要被动流量的到达频率快于主动 probe 的 TTL（默认 15 分钟），`isTTLExpired` 就永远算不出"已过期"，导致主动 probe 永远不会被重新触发，进而使"仅信任本轮新鲜证据"的优先级调度管线长期拿不到任何新证据，只能保持"keep current state"。
- 引入新字段 `Entry.LastActiveProbeAt`，专门记录"最近一次真正的主动 probe"时间（成功或失败均更新），与仅用于展示/被动合并的 `ObservedAt`彻底解耦；TTL 判断现在统一以 `LastActiveProbeAt` 为准，不再被被动流量的到达频率干扰。
- 同时处理了两个由此衍生的边界情况：(1) 从未主动 probe 过、但已有被动观测的条目（例如迁移后被被动写入抢先命中）会被强制视为过期，避免被动流量无限期饿死它；(2) 纯粹的批量错峰调度占位条目（`MarkProbeScheduled`,尚无任何观测)则维持原有的 `NextProbeAt` 错峰语义，不会被提前打断成探测风暴。
- 补充诊断日志：探测失败、apply 阶段汇总、自动并行 provider 执行以及证据收集重试耗尽时,现在都会输出到宿主进程的标准输出/错误(生产环境此前该链路完全静默，没有任何 error/panic 信号，难以定位问题)。

### English

- Fixed a bug that permanently starved Claude/Codex active probing: passive quota observation (introduced in v1.0.12) refreshes `ObservedAt` on every write, and TTL-expiry checks previously keyed directly off `ObservedAt`. Whenever passive traffic arrived more frequently than the active-probe TTL (15 minutes by default), `isTTLExpired` could never return true, so active probes were never re-triggered — starving the fresh-evidence-only priority pipeline of any new evidence and leaving it permanently stuck on "keep current state".
- Added a new `Entry.LastActiveProbeAt` field that records only genuine active-probe attempts (success or failure), fully decoupled from `ObservedAt` (which remains purely for display/passive-merge purposes). TTL expiry is now judged against `LastActiveProbeAt`, immune to passive-traffic frequency.
- Also handled two edge cases this introduced: (1) an entry with some observation but no active probe yet (e.g. one a passive write raced ahead of right after a cache migration) is now forced "expired" so passive traffic can't starve it indefinitely; (2) a pure batch/stagger scheduling placeholder (`MarkProbeScheduled`, no observation at all) still respects its original `NextProbeAt` stagger semantics instead of being pulled forward into a probe storm.
- Added diagnostic logging: probe failures, apply-stage summaries, auto-parallel provider execution, and evidence-collection retry exhaustion now print to the host process's stdout/stderr (previously this entire path was silent in production, with zero error/panic signal, making the issue very hard to locate).
